people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

translations.web: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
translations.bsb: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
translations.kjv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
translations.asv: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the congregation;
